obligations.source_text:
Create a vertical 4:5 full-length environmental fashion photograph on the open stern vehicle deck of a working car ferry underway before sunrise. Show one adult woman with long dark near-black hair in loose waves, a near-center part, restrained natural makeup, a composed closed-mouth expression, and a calm direct gaze. Use the supplied portrait solely as guidance for visible adult appearance cues, rendering an original adult subject. Place her left of center with open space to frame right. She is caught midway through a controlled pivot: left foot planted on a diagonal yellow lane stripe, right foot crossing forward, torso rotating toward the lens, left hand securing fabric at her waist, and right arm slightly separated from her silhouette.

Dress her in a deep copper-red silk-satin mantle gown. Its clean sleeveless bias-cut column base supports an asymmetric drape fastened at the left shoulder, crossed over the collarbone, gathered once at the left waist, and divided into two long free panels. A steady sea crosswind travels from frame left to frame right. The shoulder panel forms a broad high S-curve behind her; the waist panel sweeps lower across her calves and curls once near its hem. The shoulder clasp and waist gather remain visible. Continuous tension lines connect each anchor to each flying hem, compression folds collect beneath her waist hand, and diagonal pulls connect her hip to her stepping knee. Her lower hair lengths and thin background fog stream frame right in the same direction. The main body, face, fold ridges, anchors, and shoes are sharply frozen, while the final few centimeters of the flying hems carry a slight directional blur.

Light the gown with one long cool-white deck work light set low and far camera-left, grazing the cloth at a shallow angle. Render slim continuous copper-white gleams along fold faces turned toward that light; let each gleam lengthen along a ridge, then disappear as the fold rolls into a deep oxblood trough. Broad panels angled across the light remain softly copper-red. The garment reads as dense, fluid woven silk satin with broad continuous folds and physically connected fabric from anchor to hem. A small amber navigation lamp behind camera-right adds a restrained edge accent, while dim navy predawn skylight preserves natural facial detail and textured shadows.

Photograph from a low three-quarter viewpoint slightly camera-left at knee height, about 4.5 meters away with a 35 mm full-frame lens, approximately f/4, 1/800 second, ISO 800. Include the complete head, both feet, both anchors, and both hems. Let the damp blue-gray deck, broad yellow stripe, muted red ribs, safety rail, secured chain coils, and foggy stern opening remain legible around an otherwise empty vehicle lane. Finish as a cinematic on-location fashion editorial with fine realistic grain, natural skin texture, crisp cloth micro-contrast, controlled highlights, deep detailed shadows, and physically coherent reflections.

bindings.satin_surface_phrase: one continuous satin-like garment surface remains traceable from the shoulder clasp to both flying hems
bindings.satin_fold_phrase: fold ridges and curvature define a coherent drape direction from the left shoulder and waist anchors
bindings.satin_highlight_phrase: a broad smooth highlight follows those folds along the copper-red ridges
bindings.satin_dark_plane_phrase: material detail remains visible through the darker planes between adjacent luminous ridges
bindings.satin_ownership_phrase: seams and garment edges preserve surface ownership across both moving panels
